stem: In which line does the author use figurative language to explain why people participate in the simulation?

options.label: F
options.text: In a nod to a more innocent time, passengers are free to visit the pilots in the cockpit.

options.label: G
options.text: Still, for many passengers, the experience is mainly about letting dreams take wing.

options.label: H
options.text: The perky attendant runs through various drills, ending with life-vest use.

options.label: J
options.text: Because space is limited, the plane has been cut down to about two-thirds its normal length and is held in place by thick concrete pillars.
